mentions.name: nexai.app
mentions.description: Web app the author is working on, whose front-end was built with assistance from AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, etc.). The comment uses it as the context for critiquing recurring quality problems in AI-generated UI: templated beige SaaS dashboards, weak visual hierarchy, inconsistent design systems, and poorly executed micro-interactions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on nexai.app and tried leaning on Cursor/Claude/etc. for the front‑end.
